hadith:
Partnership - Narrated by Rafi bin Khadij -  Volume 3, Book 44, Number 665 

We used to offer the 'Asr prayer with the Prophet and slaughter a camel, the meat of which would be divided in ten parts. We would eat the cooked meat before sunset.
message: In the Name of Allah—the Most Beneficent, Most Merciful
name:
Al Haiyy - الْحَيُّ - The Ever Living

The name Al Haiyy signifies the attribute of life that is all-encompassing and perfect. It conveys that Allah's life is not like that of His creation; He is self-sustained and independent, contrasting with the finite nature of all living beings. This name emphasizes the importance of Allah's eternal presence and His continuous maintenance of the universe.
verse:
As-Saf - The Ranks - 61:4

Surely Allah loves those who fight in His cause in ˹solid˺ ranks as if they were one concrete structure.
